title: hive-pool update: request body
description: Applies a patch to one item and reports which fields changed. A patch that changes nothing writes nothing. A patch that sets level to target on an imported item that has none is the conversion of spec/pool.md, Levels: allowed only while the item has no generation, no Imperative and is queued, and it removes the deliverable, the requested placement and the delivery axes in the same transaction and reports them among the changed fields. The envelope's expected_revisions names the item's revision. See spec/pool.md, Items.

add_body_lines.description: Lines appended to the body when not already present.

level.description: The item's level, set only on an item that has none, as its owner sets it on an imported legacy item; a change of an existing level is refused with pool.hierarchy. Setting target is allowed only while the item has no generation, no Imperative and is queued, and is refused with pool.hierarchy otherwise; in the same transaction the Pool removes the deliverable, the requested placement and the delivery axes, which a Target never carries, and reports them among the fields that changed. Setting prey or hunt keeps them.

wave.description: On a Target only; refused where the item's level is not target.

placement_requested.description: A change of the requested place after a generation opened does not touch that generation; the next generation reads it.

definition.description: needed or defining may be set here. accepted is set only by hive-spec accept.

add_deps.description: The parent rule of spec/pool.md, Levels, holds for the item as the patch leaves it: a Hunt has exactly one parent edge, to a Prey; a Prey at most one, to a Target; a Target none; a violation, or a Hunt attached to a Prey that carries the completion marker or has an open generation, is refused with pool.hierarchy.

remove_deps.description: Removing the only parent edge of a Hunt is refused with pool.hierarchy unless the same patch adds another.
